## Summary
Describe what changed and why.

## Legal / safety / security release gate
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, MFA codes or sensitive customer data added
- [ ] Entity/brand/product identity correct
- [ ] Age/minor/COPPA impact reviewed if customer-facing
- [ ] Third-party fonts/scripts/SDKs documented
- [ ] Tracking/session replay/privacy impact reviewed
- [ ] Subscription/payment/cancellation impact reviewed
- [ ] Email/SMS marketing compliance impact reviewed
- [ ] UGC/DMCA/community safety impact reviewed
- [ ] Claims/testimonials/performance language substantiated
- [ ] AI/IP/license/likeness rights reviewed
- [ ] Auth/authz/tenant isolation tested where relevant
- [ ] Dependency/secret/security checks passed
- [ ] Incident/rollback/kill-switch impact considered
- [ ] Accessibility reviewed if customer-facing
- [ ] Required counsel/compliance escalation completed
- [ ] Final state: GO / HOLD / NO-GO

Any unresolved P0 means **do not merge/deploy**.
